research_scope: Binance deposit and post-incident reserve hypotheses

event_timeline.event: Visible raRVLN-to-r39TA transfer sequence begins; six payments total 186M XRP through 14:09 UTC
Previously captured r39TA-to-Binance-labelled rNxp4h deposits begin
Previously captured six r39TA-to-rNxp4h deposits end, totaling 68,924,571.602513 XRP
r39TA sends 9,999,197.11 XRP and 10M XRP to Binance-labelled rNxp4h using destination tag 499932645
TrackWhale seven-day tracked-large-transfer snapshot reports net exchange outflow of 97.28M XRP
Bithomp account overview pages show rJqi 30.5M XRP, raRVLN 19.6M, r39TA 5.9M and rNxp4h 204.2M XRP

market_observations.caveat: Partial transaction window; no same-unit provenance after receipt.
AMM pool/vault/loan-broker intermediary; no same-unit provenance.
Dynamic overview and partial transaction history; balance change is consistent with, but does not prove, onward movement of the 20M receipt.
Balance is not classified as customer, hot, cold or reserve inventory.
Latest completed flow predates Binance XRP outflow at 20:05 UTC on October 29.
Fund coverage and adjustments differ from Maketo.

findings.statement: Bithomp shows rJqi with Xaman Account: Ripple and activation by a Ripple-labelled account; this is stronger attribution evidence than a generic unlabeled wallet but is not legal beneficial-ownership proof.
Bithomp displays 35M XRP from rJqi to raRVLN at 20:07 UTC, after earlier 28M and 120M transfers to the same account.
Bithomp shows rJqi funded/activated rP4X2h with 70M XRP in 2023, and rP4X2h activated raRVLN with 2,000 XRP in 2024; this creates an account-lineage edge, not proof of common beneficial ownership.
XRPLWin classifies raRVLN as an AMM pool and says it belongs to a vault and a loan broker; the pair, vault, loan-broker and collateral objects remain unresolved.
Bithomp displays a 20M XRP payment from raRVLN to unlabelled r39TA at 20:16 UTC.

Bithomp displays two 20:47 UTC payments from r39TA to Binance-labelled rNxp4h totaling 19,999,197.11 XRP, with destination tag 499932645; together with six earlier deposits, visible transfers total 88,923,768.712513 XRP.

Bithomp labels rNxp4h as Binance, reports 204.2M XRP and signer status for five addresses, and shows historical activation by rDAE53, one of the five incident source accounts; this predates the incident and does not establish compromise or PoR inclusion.
TrackWhale's seven-day tracked-large-transfer sample shows net exchange outflow of 97.28M XRP despite the specific r39TA deposit route; this is not a full exchange-flow measure.
The latest completed October 29 ETF flows predate the first identified Binance XRP drain at 20:05 UTC, so they cannot be a response to that incident.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Ripple-associated treasury or institutional liquidity routing passed through an AMM/vault/loan-broker account and an intermediary before Binance deposit.
supporting_evidence: rJqi has a Ripple Xaman label and Ripple activation history.
rJqi transferred 35M XRP to raRVLN at 20:07 UTC.
rJqi historically funded rP4X2h, which activated raRVLN.
raRVLN transferred 20M XRP to r39TA at 20:16 UTC; r39TA sent about 20M to Binance-labelled rNxp4h at 20:47 UTC.
disconfirming_evidence: r39TA has no identified owner or service.
rNxp4h is not established as a reserve wallet.
No instruction, contract, settlement or sale record links the parties.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Market-maker inventory rebalancing through an AMM pool followed by exchange deposit.
supporting_evidence: raRVLN is classified as an AMM pool and associated vault/loan broker.
Large XRP transfers and a destination-tagged Binance deposit are consistent with inventory routing.
disconfirming_evidence: No market maker, trading strategy, pool pair or executed order is identified.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Vault or loan-broker collateral settlement generated the observed XRP transfers.
supporting_evidence: XRPLWin associates raRVLN with a vault and loan broker.
The route includes large XRP movements and partial RLUSD activity at the intermediary.
disconfirming_evidence: No vault ID, loan record, collateral posting, borrower, lender or liquidation is resolved.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The route is a mixture of unrelated user deposits and shared AMM activity rather than one institution-directed flow.
supporting_evidence: r39TA is unlabelled and activated by an unlabelled account.
AMM pools are shared liquidity mechanisms.
rNxp4h uses a destination tag and receives ordinary deposits from multiple venues.
disconfirming_evidence: Repeated large transfers and the historical rJqi→rP4X2h→raRVLN activation lineage make the sequence worth further investigation.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The r39TA deposits represent Binance's post-incident XRP replenishment purchases.
supporting_evidence: Binance announced aggregate acquisition of affected tokens and the destination is Binance-labelled.
disconfirming_evidence: No XRP-specific acquisition amount is disclosed.
rNxp4h is not proven to be a reserve address.
The source is unlabelled and could be customer deposits.
No reserve accounting or executed purchase is shown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Ripple-associated route establishes immediate XRP sell pressure or a direct price effect.
supporting_evidence: A portion of XRP reached a Binance-labelled account.
disconfirming_evidence: No order-book fill or OTC settlement is identified.
TrackWhale's tracked sample is net outflow over seven days.
ETF flows predate the incident and market data are not synchronized.

data_quality.source_independence: Bithomp, XRPLWin and TrackWhale read the same public XRPL ledger; different explorers/indexers corroborate presentation but not independent underlying transactions.
data_quality.account_balance_semantics: Explorer overview balances are point-in-time and may be cached or rounded; transaction histories are partial and not necessarily synchronized to overview capture.
data_quality.market_coverage: ETF aggregators and derivatives dashboards use different fund/contract universes and cutoffs; no cross-provider averaging.
data_quality.feature_admission: All on-chain account-route, ETF, derivatives and large-transfer observations remain NOT_ADMITTED pending synchronized historical panel and leakage-safe validation.

next_actions: Crosswalk the five compromised Binance XRPL source accounts, rNxp4h and XRP-BF2 reserve address against the official October 1 Binance PoR export.
Resolve raRVLN AMM pair, vault ID, loan-broker ID and collateral objects from a rate-limit-safe XRPL data source.
Reconcile r39TA's complete XRP/RLUSD history and identify the service or beneficial owner only from public evidence.
Monitor rNxp4h separately from the attacker receiver; distinguish deposit, inventory, reserve, replenishment and sale.
Reconcile ETF holdings and derivative contracts by provider and venue before feature admission.
Build fixed-horizon XRP outcomes and point-in-time features; keep shadow evaluation separate from live trading.
